import sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import t_perf2
from common import validate

src=open('/workspace/submission/planning.py').read()
src=src.replace("from protocols import probe_script","probe_script=__import__('protocols').probe_script")
src=src.replace("    potential=[0]*count\n    value=0\n    parent=[-1]*count",
 "    potential=[0]*count\n    value=0\n    parent=[-1]*count\n    STATS['phases']+=0")
src=src.replace("        if distance[sink]==INFINITY:\n            break",
                "        STATS['phases']+=1\n        if distance[sink]==INFINITY:\n            break")
src=src.replace("                for edge in adj[u]:\n                    if cap[edge]>0:\n                        head=to[edge]\n                        if not seen[head]:",
 "                for edge in adj[u]:\n                    STATS['scans']+=1\n                    if cap[edge]>0:\n                        head=to[edge]\n                        if not seen[head]:")
src=src.replace("                            push(heap,(reach,head))","                            push(heap,(reach,head)); STATS['pushes']+=1")
src=src.replace("            room=min(cap[edge] for edge in path)\n            for edge in path:",
                "            STATS['aug']+=1\n            room=min(cap[edge] for edge in path)\n            for edge in path:")
src=src.replace("SOURCE = 0","import builtins\nSTATS={'phases':0,'scans':0,'pushes':0,'aug':0}\nSOURCE = 0")
ns={}
exec(compile(src,'p','exec'),ns)
job=t_perf2.build(7,nreq=256,noffer=512,pairs=16384)
ctx=validate(job)
t=time.time()
res=ns['solve'](ctx,{r['id']:True for r in job['requests']})
print('seconds %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
print(json.dumps(ns['STATS']))
print(res['resolved'],res['cost'])
PYEOF
